response.original_title: 【Simple_Steps】 How do I add a cabin to my Norwegian Cruise?
response.overview: To add another cabin to an existing Norwegian Cruise 1-866-254-7549 reservation, you must book a separate new statecabin and call Norwegian Cruise customer service at +1-866-254-7549(US) or contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. Book a separate cabin: You cannot add a cabin to an existing reservation through the online website or mobile app. Book a new statecabin online or via phone. Contact Norwegian Cruise at +1-866-254-7549(US) or your travel agent.
